description: Transport Infrastructure Ireland open data portal (traffic counters) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Transport Infrastructure Ireland (TII). Search summaries describe the portal as the home of TII datasets, with raw and aggregated traffic counter data from almost 300 active counters on the national primary and secondary roads, published daily as CSV files (per-vehicle records and aggregates by vehicle class). Coverage: Ireland national road network. Formats and interfaces named: CSV. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the portal page returned an error message in place of content, so the counter numbers, formats and licence come from search summaries and are unverified. It can support traffic demand and network load studies on Irish national roads. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30 but its text could not be read; statements come from search result summaries; the data themselves were not downloaded.
